cases.sentence: В средине моста, слезши с лошади, прижатый своим ___ к перилам, стоял князь Несвицкий.
cases.explain: «толстым телом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Two of the enemy’s shots had already flown across the bridge, where there was a crush. Halfway across stood Prince Nesvítski, who had alighted from his horse and whose big body was jammed against the railings. He looked back laughing to the Cossack who stood a few steps behind him holding two horses by their bridles. Each time Prince Nesvítski tried to move on, soldiers and carts pushed him back again and pressed him against the railings, and all he could do was to smile.

cases.sentence: — говорил казак ___ с повозкой, напиравшему на толпившуюся у самых колес и лошадей пехоту, — экой ты!
cases.explain: «фурштатскому солдату» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: “What a fine fellow you are, friend!” said the Cossack to a convoy soldier with a wagon, who was pressing onto the infantrymen who were crowded together close to his wheels and his horses. “What a fellow! You can’t wait a moment! Don’t you see the general wants to pass?”

cases.sentence: — Как он (он — неприятель) таперича по мосту примется зажаривать, — говорил мрачно ___, обращаясь к товарищу, — забудешь чесаться.
cases.explain: «старый солдат» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “If he” (“he” meant the enemy) “begins popping at the bridge now,” said the old soldier dismally to a comrade, “you’ll forget to scratch yourself.”

cases.explain: «другой солдат» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: That soldier passed on, and after him came another sitting on a cart.

cases.sentence: — Как он его, ___, полыхнет прикладом-то в самые зубы...
cases.explain: «милый человек» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “And then, old fellow, he gives him one in the teeth with the butt end of his gun …” a soldier whose greatcoat was well tucked up said gaily, with a wide swing of his arm.

cases.sentence: — радостно говорил один солдат в ___, широко размахивая рукой.
cases.explain: «высокоподоткнутой шинели» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: “And then, old fellow, he gives him one in the teeth with the butt end of his gun …” a soldier whose greatcoat was well tucked up said gaily, with a wide swing of his arm.

cases.sentence: — Как оно пролетит мимо меня, дяденька, ядро-то, — говорил, едва удерживаясь от смеха, с ___ молодой солдат, — я так и обмер.
cases.explain: «огромным ртом» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “As it flies past me, Daddy, the ball I mean,” said a young soldier with an enormous mouth, hardly refraining from laughing, “I felt like dying of fright. I did, ’pon my word, I got that frightened!” said he, as if bragging of having been frightened.

cases.sentence: Это был немецкий форшпан на паре, нагруженный, казалось, ___; за форшпаном, который вез немец, привязана была красивая, пестрая, с огромным вымем, корова.
cases.explain: «целым домом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: That one also passed. Then followed a cart unlike any that had gone before. It was a German cart with a pair of horses led by a German, and seemed loaded with a whole houseful of effects. A fine brindled cow with a large udder was attached to the cart behind. A woman with an unweaned baby, an old woman, and a healthy German girl with bright red cheeks were sitting on some feather beds. Evidently these fugitives were allowed to pass by special permission. The eyes of all the soldiers turned toward the women, and while the vehicle was passing at foot pace all the soldiers’ remarks related to the two young ones. Every face bore almost the same smile, expressing unseemly thoughts about the women.

cases.sentence: Видно, по ___ были пропущены эти выселявшиеся жители.
cases.explain: «особому разрешению» — after the preposition «по», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.

cases.sentence: На всех лицах была почти одна и та же улыбка ___ об этой женщине.
cases.explain: «непристойных мыслей» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
